task_summary.title: Security audit and compliance scanning for production systems
task_summary.description: Comprehensive security audit of commit-relay production codebase including dependency scanning, code analysis, and OWASP compliance checking

deliverables.description: Comprehensive security audit report with findings, recommendations, and compliance status

key_findings: No critical or high severity vulnerabilities found
Good input validation and parameterized queries prevent injection attacks
Demo-quality cryptography needs production replacement before deployment
recommended_actions: Replace demo API key hashing with bcrypt/argon2 (HIGH priority)
Remove reset tokens from API responses (MEDIUM priority)
Add rate limiting to sensitive endpoints (MEDIUM priority)
execution_notes: Dashboard API health confirmed before scan
SQL injection protection verified via parameterized queries
